main_text.p: chismos, & Confessiones Fidei reconcinnare, quasi nulla priùs extitisset in hac Ecclesia doctrina sana omninò aut perspicua circa vel ipsa Fidei elementa, quàm Quinquennii hujus proximi deliberatio hoc negotium integrè maturasset:

Istaquidem omnia & his similia, quæ vulgò fieri solent (ne nil facere videantur) ab his Reformationum larvis quibus breve aucupantur Plebis Gratiam (quæ his Novitatum illecebris non secùs ac Pueri Imagunculis vehementer quidē sed non diu afficitur) tantum abest ut merean-tur Reformationis laudem, ut revera (quantum ad Charitatem, Pietatem, Rectum Ordinem, & Mores spectat) turbida magis omnia & querula & confusa relinquantur, quàm, ubi primò inchoaverant.
Haud enim facili operâ mala illa prio-ra & detrimenta maxima pensare licebit aut corrigere, satis carè ab illis conciliata, & necessariò semper futura, ni remedia debita adhibeantur.
Id utinam seriò tandem & unanimiter vellent Dei opus agere, non suum. Multis sanè[?] incommodis obviam itum fuisset, in Religionem (prout dignum erat ) priò loco spectâssent.
Illud vero haud absurdè existima-ant nonnulli, Ecclesiæ & Status Re-gimen,

page.notes: Running head set in Greek capitals as printed (ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ). The word after "Multis" at the start of the next line is partly obscured; read as "sanè" with [?]. Italic "prout dignum erat" was given with the closing parenthesis outside the italic run. The line "priò loco" is hyphenated "pri-/ò" in print and is joined here. Page number 185 is read from the head; the final digit is slightly worn.
